question: How much will Crude Oil Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: P0 = Nov 20 close (Yahoo CL=F already maps to the Jan-27 contract, so the roll effect is small); P1 = Dec 4 close, 10 trading days. Reference class: 10-trading-day CL-minus-ES return spreads in the current high-vol regime, roughly zero-mean, with SD set by oil vol (OVX ~52) and equity vol (VIX ~32). Oil is trending down on recovering Middle East exports, and ES is in a 10% correction after 6+ straight losses; possible oversold and Thanksgiving-week equity bounce leans the median slightly negative, but drift is weak next to the ~9-10pp SD. Fat tails: a renewed supply shock plus equity crash could push the spread above +25; an oil collapse plus equity rally could push it below -25. No human market prices this spread.
